thread.title: Looking for a Reason to Be Bullish on Stocks? Try This One Chart

author: thestreet.com
title: Looking for a Reason to Be Bullish on Stocks? Try This One Chart
text:
Here's one chart that will validate your innermost desire for more market gains , bulls.
Equity option buyers remain bearish (chart below), duly notes Schaeffer's Investment Research senior vice president Todd Salamone . That has proven to be a good contrarian indicator on the market.
"Pessimism in this area of the market is around levels that have preceded rallies since early 2017, with the 10-day ratio of equity-only put buying relative to call buying far above the multi-year lows that occurred prior to the late-January/early February correction," Salamone says.
If studying options markets isn't your thing, then other occurrences in the market right now will probably also leave one short-term bullish.
Source: Schaeffer's Investment Research
As discussed in TheStreet's Jolt newsletter , eighteen sectors of the market are positive year to date, up from just three in early February, according to Yardeni Research. The best-performing sectors year to date are a whose who of speculation.
Small-cap healthcare is up 16.9% on prospects for more M&A. Large-cap tech has gained 11.2% on prospects for world domination from Action Alerts Plus holdings like Facebook ( FB ) , Amazon ( AMZN ) , Apple ( AAPL ) , Netflix ( NFLX ) and Alphabet's Google ( GOOGL ) . Large-cap consumer discretionary has tacked on 7.5% on hopes for a U.S. consumer spending boom this spring.
Meanwhile, the collective valuations of U.S. tech stocks, as well as online retailer and Action Alerts Plus holding Amazon, have now topped $7 trillion.
